record.bible_text: Therefore, thou son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, prophesy<WH05012><WTH8734> against Gog<WH01463>, and say<WH0559><WTH8804>, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Behold, I <FI>am<Fi> against thee, O Gog<WH01463>, the chief<WH07218> prince<WH05387> of Meshech<WH04902> and Tubal<WH08422>:

And I will turn thee back<WH07725><WTH8790>, and leave but the sixth part<WH08338><WTH8765> of thee, and will cause thee to come up<WH05927><WTH8689> from the north<WH06828> parts<WH03411>, and will bring<WH0935><WTH8689> thee upon the mountains<WH02022> of Israel<WH03478>: <RF>leave...: or, strike thee with six plagues: or, draw thee back with an hook of six teeth<Rf> <RF>the north...: Heb. the sides of the north<Rf>
And I will smite<WH05221><WTH8689> thy bow<WH07198> out of thy left<WH08040> hand<WH03027>, and will cause thine arrows<WH02671> to fall<WH05307><WTH8686> out of thy right<WH03225> hand<WH03027>.

Thou shalt fall<WH05307><WTH8799> upon the mountains<WH02022> of Israel<WH03478>, thou, and all thy bands<WH0102>, and the people<WH05971> that <FI>is<Fi> with thee: I will give<WH05414><WTH8804> thee unto the ravenous<WH05861> birds<WH06833> of every sort<WH03671>, and <FI>to<Fi> the beasts<WH02416> of the field<WH07704> to be devoured<WH0402>. <RF>sort: Heb. wing<Rf> <RF>to be...: Heb. to devour<Rf>

Thou shalt fall<WH05307><WTH8799> upon the open<WH06440> field<WH07704>: for I have spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi> , saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>. <RF>the open...: Heb. the face of the field<Rf>

And I will send<WH07971><WTH8765> a fire<WH0784> on Magog<WH04031>, and among them that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> carelessly<WH0983> in the isles<WH0339>: and they shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi>  the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>carelessly: or, confidently<Rf>

So will I make my holy<WH06944> name<WH08034> known<WH03045><WTH8686> in the midst<WH08432> of my people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478>; and I will not <FI>let them<Fi> pollute<WH02490><WTH8686> my holy<WH06944> name<WH08034> any more: and the heathen<WH01471> shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>, the Holy One<WH06918> in Israel<WH03478>.<CM>
Behold, it is come<WH0935><WTH8804>, and it is done<WH01961><WTH8738>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; this <FI>is<Fi> the day<WH03117> whereof I have spoken<WH01696><WTH8765>.

And they that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> in the cities<WH05892> of Israel<WH03478> shall go forth<WH03318><WTH8804>, and shall set<WH01197><WTH8765> on fire<WH0784> and burn<WH05400><WTH8689> the weapons<WH05402>, both the shields<WH04043> and the bucklers<WH06793>, the bows<WH07198> and the arrows<WH02671>, and the handstaves<WH03027><WH04731>, and the spears<WH07420>, and they shall burn<WH01197><WTH8765> them with fire<WH0784> seven<WH07651> years<WH08141>: <RF>handstaves: or, javelins<Rf> <RF>burn them...: or, make a fire of them<Rf>

So that they shall take<WH05375><WTH8799> no wood<WH06086> out of the field<WH07704>, neither cut down<WH02404><WTH8799> <FI>any<Fi> out of the forests<WH03293>; for they shall burn<WH01197><WTH8762> the weapons<WH05402> with fire<WH0784>: and they shall spoil<WH07997><WTH8804> those that spoiled<WH07997><WTH8802> them, and rob<WH0962><WTH8804> those that robbed<WH0962><WTH8802> them, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.

And it shall come to pass in that day<WH03117>, <FI>that<Fi> I will give<WH05414><WTH8799> unto Gog<WH01463> a place<WH04725> there of graves<WH06913> in Israel<WH03478>, the valley<WH01516> of the passengers<WH05674><WTH8802> on the east<WH06926> of the sea<WH03220>: and it shall stop<WH02629><WTH8802> the <FI>noses<Fi> of the passengers<WH05674><WTH8802>: and there shall they bury<WH06912><WTH8804> Gog<WH01463> and all his multitude<WH01995>: and they shall call<WH07121><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> The valley<WH01516> of Hamongog<WH01996>. <RF>noses: or, mouths<Rf> <RF>Hamongog: that is, The multitude of Gog<Rf>
And seven<WH07651> months<WH02320> shall the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478> be burying<WH06912><WTH8804> of them, that they may cleanse<WH02891><WTH8763> the land<WH0776>.

Yea, all the people<WH05971> of the land<WH0776> shall bury<WH06912><WTH8804> <FI>them<Fi> ; and it shall be to them a renown<WH08034> the day<WH03117> that I shall be glorified<WH03513><WTH8736>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.

And they shall sever out<WH0914><WTH8686> men<WH0582> of continual employment<WH08548>, passing through<WH05674><WTH8802> the land<WH0776> to bury<WH06912><WTH8764> with the passengers<WH05674><WTH8802> those that remain<WH03498><WTH8737> upon the face<WH06440> of the earth<WH0776>, to cleanse<WH02891><WTH8763> it: after the end<WH07097> of seven<WH07651> months<WH02320> shall they search<WH02713><WTH8799>. <RF>men...: Heb. men of continuance<Rf>

And the passengers<WH05674><WTH8802> <FI>that<Fi> pass through<WH05674><WTH8804> the land<WH0776>, when <FI>any<Fi> seeth<WH07200><WTH8804> a man's<WH0120> bone<WH06106>, then shall he set up<WH01129><WTH8804> a sign<WH06725> by<WH0681> it, till the buriers<WH06912><WTH8764> have buried<WH06912><WTH8804> it in the valley<WH01516> of Hamongog<WH01996>. <RF>set up: Heb. build<Rf>
And also the name<WH08034> of the city<WH05892> <FI>shall be<Fi> Hamonah<WH01997>. Thus shall they cleanse<WH02891><WTH8765> the land<WH0776>. <RF>Hamonah: that is, The multitude<Rf>

And, thou son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Speak<WH0559><WTH8798> unto every feathered<WH03671> fowl<WH06833>, and to every beast<WH02416> of the field<WH07704>, Assemble<WH06908><WTH8734> yourselves, and come<WH0935><WTH8798>; gather<WH0622><WTH8734> yourselves on every side<WH05439> to my sacrifice<WH02077> that I do sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8802> for you, <FI>even<Fi> a great<WH01419> sacrifice<WH02077> upon the mountains<WH02022> of Israel<WH03478>, that ye may eat<WH0398><WTH8804> flesh<WH01320>, and drink<WH08354><WTH8804> blood<WH01818>. <RF>unto...: Heb. to the fowl of every wing<Rf> <RF>my sacrifice: or, my slaughter<Rf>

Ye shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the flesh<WH01320> of the mighty<WH01368>, and drink<WH08354><WTH8799> the blood<WH01818> of the princes<WH05387> of the earth<WH0776>, of rams<WH0352>, of lambs<WH03733>, and of goats<WH06260>, of bullocks<WH06499>, all of them fatlings<WH04806> of Bashan<WH01316>. <RF>goats: Heb. great goats<Rf>

And ye shall eat<WH0398><WTH8804> fat<WH02459> till ye be full<WH07654>, and drink<WH08354><WTH8804> blood<WH01818> till ye be drunken<WH07943>, of my sacrifice<WH02077> which I have sacrificed<WH02076><WTH8804> for you.

Thus ye shall be filled<WH07646><WTH8804> at my table<WH07979> with horses<WH05483> and chariots<WH07393>, with mighty men<WH01368>, and with all men<WH0376> of war<WH04421>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.

And I will set<WH05414><WTH8804> my glory<WH03519> among the heathen<WH01471>, and all the heathen<WH01471> shall see<WH07200><WTH8804> my judgment<WH04941> that I have executed<WH06213><WTH8804>, and my hand<WH03027> that I have laid<WH07760><WTH8804> upon them.
So the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478> shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> their God<WH0430> from that day<WH03117> and forward<WH01973>.<CM>

And the heathen<WH01471> shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478> went into captivity<WH01540><WTH8804> for their iniquity<WH05771>: because they trespassed<WH04603><WTH8804> against me, therefore hid<WH05641><WTH8686> I my face<WH06440> from them, and gave<WH05414><WTH8799> them into the hand<WH03027> of their enemies<WH06862>: so fell<WH05307><WTH8799> they all by the sword<WH02719>.
According to their uncleanness<WH02932> and according to their transgressions<WH06588> have I done<WH06213><WTH8804> unto them, and hid<WH05641><WTH8686> my face<WH06440> from them.

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Now will I bring again<WH07725><WTH8686> the captivity<WH07622><WTH8675><WH07622> of Jacob<WH03290>, and have mercy<WH07355><WTH8765> upon the whole house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>, and will be jealous<WH07065><WTH8765> for my holy<WH06944> name<WH08034>;

After that they have borne<WH05375><WTH8804> their shame<WH03639>, and all their trespasses<WH04604> whereby they have trespassed<WH04603><WTH8804> against me, when they dwelt<WH03427><WTH8800> safely<WH0983> in their land<WH0127>, and none made <FI>them<Fi> afraid<WH02729><WTH8688>.

When I have brought them again<WH07725><WTH8788> from the people<WH05971>, and gathered<WH06908><WTH8765> them out of their enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>' lands<WH0776>, and am sanctified<WH06942><WTH8738> in them in the sight<WH05869> of many<WH07227> nations<WH01471>;

Then shall they know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> their God<WH0430>, which caused them to be led into captivity<WH01540><WTH8687> among the heathen<WH01471>: but I have gathered<WH03664><WTH8765> them unto their own land<WH0127>, and have left<WH03498><WTH8686> none of them any more there. <RF>which...: Heb. by my causing of them, etc<Rf>

Neither will I hide<WH05641><WTH8686> my face<WH06440> any more from them: for I have poured out<WH08210><WTH8804> my spirit<WH07307> upon the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.<CM>
